text: They shall devastate the land of Assyria with the sword and The land of Nimrod within her [own] gates. And He (the Messiah) shall rescue us from the Assyrian (all enemy nations) When he attacks our land And when he tramples our territory.
Your hand will be lifted up against your adversaries, And all your enemies shall be cut off and destroyed.
"And in anger and wrath I shall execute vengeance On the nations which have not obeyed [such vengeance as they have not known before]."
